answer: Red Dune's pump roster was gamed when one factor printed extra harvest chits and collected the same barley ration six times. A claimant must now walk into the oasis pump house, split a 9 mm barley kernel under the clerk's lens, and seat a 7 mm drilled river pearl in a numbered wax cup that stays locked beside 13.2 coin for 18 hours. Two wardens rematch the fracture photo to that cup and to the pearl's drill hole. A second chit would need a second body at the well, a fresh kernel, and a second pearl. Shared fractures or a reused cup burns both deposits and chains that pump for eleven nights.
